stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 submodule [--init] [<subcommand>] [--] [<args>...]

Manage submodules.

Subcommands:
    status [<name>...]            Show submodule status
    add <url> <path>              Add a new submodule
    init [<name>...]              Copy submodule config into .git/config
    update [--init] [<name>...]   Clone or update submodules
    sync [<name>...]              Sync submodule URL configuration

Options:
    --init
        initialize submodules before updating
    <subcommand>
        the subcommand (status, add, init, update, sync)
    <args>...
        arguments for the subcommand
